title: 1987 AHSME Problem 8
statement: In the figure the sum of the distances \(AD\) and \(BD\) is

solutions.text:
Triangle \(BCD\) is a \(3\)-\(4\)-\(5\) right triangle, so \(BD=5.\) From \(A\) to \(D,\) the horizontal displacement is \(13-3=10\) and the vertical displacement is \(4,\) hence \[ AD=\sqrt{10^2+4^2}=\sqrt{116}. \] Since \(10\lt\sqrt{116}\lt11,\) the sum \(AD+BD\) is between \(15\) and \(16.\)

Thus the correct answer is C.
hints: Use the \(3\)-\(4\)-\(5\) right triangle to find \(BD\)
The horizontal and vertical displacements from \(A\) to \(D\) are \(10\) and \(4\)
